transcript: Hello, please come in. What is the child's name and age? Aarav is four years old. He has had a cough and cold for two days, and also has a fever. How much fever is there? Any difficulty breathing at night? I went until 101 at night. My breath is fine, just my nose remains blocked. Right now the temperature is 100.6. Oxygen, meaning SPO2, is 98 percent. Great. I have weighed 16 kilos. Doctor, the elder son had an Azithral bottle lying in the house. I gave him one dose last night. No, stop that. This is a viral infection, an upper respiratory tract infection. There is no need for antibiotics in this. Don't give antibiotics without asking. Yes, it's fine. He/she doesn't have any medicine for the allergy. Okay. For fever, Paracetamol syrup, Calpol 250, 5 ml, only when the fever is above 100, not more than four times a day, for three days. For a cold, Cetirizine syrup, 2.5 ml, five days before going to sleep at night. He is eating less, what should I do? Keep giving water and lentil water little by little. If the breath is fast, the ribs are moving, the child stops drinking water, or if there is a seizure, bring them immediately to the emergency. Yes, I understood. Then when did you come? Show it after 3 days, even if the fever persists.
